newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy budget to go to Senate on December 10.
newsitem.headline: Italy budget to go to Senate on December 10.

text.p: The upper house of Italy's parliament, the Senate, will give the 1997 budget bill a reading from December 10 after the legislation has passed through the Senate's budget committee.

Under a calendar agreed by leaders of all parliamentary groups represented in the Senate, a number of committees in the upper house will be asked to express an opinion on the budget to the budget committee by November 27.
The budget committee will in turn have until December 6 to look at the bill before it goes before the house for a full reading.
The government was hoping to secure approval of the bill from the lower house on Thursday but political commentators said this could be delayed until the weekend.
